title: Monster holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- fuzzy green monster body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="30" ry="30" fill="#3fbf5a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="30" ry="30" fill="#5ee07a" opacity="0.35"/>
  <!-- fur tufts on top -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="34" r="7" fill="#3fbf5a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="28" r="8" fill="#4ed06a"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="34" r="7" fill="#3fbf5a"/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <polygon points="30,40 24,22 38,32" fill="#f2c14e"/>
  <polygon points="70,40 76,22 62,32" fill="#f2c14e"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="56" r="9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="56" r="9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="57" r="4.5" fill="#7b2fd6"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="57" r="4.5" fill="#7b2fd6"/>
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="55.5" r="1.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="55.5" r="1.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d="M42 72 Q50 80 58 72" stroke="#c81d6e" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little fangs -->
  <polygon points="44,72 47,72 45.5,77" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <polygon points="53,72 56,72 54.5,77" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- arms reaching up to heart -->
  <path d="M26 66 Q20 50 38 44" stroke="#3fbf5a" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M74 66 Q80 50 62 44" stroke="#3fbf5a" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d="M50 44 C44 34 30 36 30 45 C30 52 40 58 50 64 C60 58 70 52 70 45 C70 36 56 34 50 44 Z" fill="#ff3d6e"/>
  <path d="M50 44 C44 34 30 36 30 45 C30 52 40 58 50 64 C60 58 70 52 70 45 C70 36 56 34 50 44 Z" fill="#ff7d9c" opacity="0.4"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="44" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#ffd0dc"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="90" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#2ea346"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="90" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#2ea346"/>
</svg>
